design.owner_queue: At most one pending request; pump executes at most one request per frame, only on its creating owner thread. Worker get waits at most 50 ms before checking cancellation/close again.
design.history_read_limit: 32 immutable batches of at most 1024 validated key/Edit pairs per owner request: at most 32768 pairs. Rebuilding indices and emitting placement replay happen on worker.
design.stale_guard: Captured indexed history identity/revision, offline-world identity and exact immutable engine-prepared cell-map identity must match at final owner commit. Source mutations between groups reject before cursor resume; mutations after staging reject before publication. Outside-destination history edits require retry, not overwriting.
design.survival_state: Inventory, health and drops are not captured in history staging. Final existing save uses current owner-thread state.
design.compatibility: Legacy/custom nonindexed map histories keep their original synchronous commit path.
design.cleanup: Cancellation/close releases queued reads. Worker errors close engine.Prepared; completion/cancel cleanup retains the existing resource lifecycle. History failure can be retried without a stuck placement reservation.

probe.method: Separate JVMs, synchronous mode first, three warmups and 20 iterations. History-only baseline reproduces the prior copyOf plus rememberCell algorithm on unchanged WorldVoxels, not a separately compiled parent/full commit. Fixture has 100000 source edits and 1000 immutable uniform new cells; ordered serialized Edit hashes match at 101000 edits after every iteration. Fixture construction and serialized-hash validation are outside timing; target history/index construction is inside. The staged path uses actual LocalGame.stageStructureHistory and StructureOwnerQueue; each owner pump is timed and the maximum per run is recorded. Thirty-three-ms sleeps simulate cadence without a renderer; not actual FPS or frame-time qualification. Reflection reads only private synthetic staged history for validation, avoiding a mutable public getter. Owner allocation includes queue/thread/task bookkeeping and owner read arrays; worker allocation includes queue tasks, detached index construction and placement replay. No retained/peak memory measure. Sync worker fields are zero because it has no worker.
probe.tradeoff: History-phase owner max-per-run worst fell 145.748 to 3.601 ms; wall p95 increased 88.848 to 266.902 ms. Median total allocated bytes increased from 9617488 to 14899864 (806848 owner plus 14093016 worker) because the staged path rebuilds a detached cell index. Not a complete 100 ms main-thread guarantee or full placement/save timing.
